basic_info.description: Rare Commercial Office Condominium with access to common deck & Views Near Ghirardelli Square.  Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a commercial office condominium in one of San Francisco's most desirable locations,just steps from Ghirardelli Square. This flexible space features total sq ft of 881 comprised of a front  office area (approx. 417 sq ft), ideal for accommodating staff, clients, or creative workspace design. The rear area is comprised of a large storage area (approx. 464 sq ft) and opens directly onto a stunning 600 sq ft common deck with sweeping views perfect for entertaining, casual meetings or taking a break in style. Additional highlights include two separate storage rooms and a half bathroom. A unique blend of functionality, location, and outdoor space ideal for professionals seeking something special.
